description: This file defines a utility function for cascade deletion of a chapter and all related data within a learning application. It handles removal of chapter files, questions, attempts, images, RAG conversations, embeddings, and the chapter entry itself from storage systems.

classes.name: LocalVectorStore
classes.description: A class representing a local vector store used to store and manage vector embeddings and associated metadata.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] cascade_delete_chapter(chapter_id: int, storage: JSONStorage)
methods.description: Deletes a chapter and all related data entries such as PDF files, questions, attempts, images, RAG conversations, and embeddings, updating the storage accordingly.

ctags.name: cascade_delete_chapter
ctags.pattern: /^def cascade_delete_chapter(chapter_id: int, storage: JSONStorage) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/
